source.source_rights_note: Official Bungie upload of the Destiny 2: The Witch Queen launch trailer. Used only in a non-commercial fan creation under Bungie's fan-content forbearance. The repository stores metadata and timestamps, never the footage.

intro.why: Act II's CLEAN front (renders/efmb-front.mkv, 76.600s) -- the 'evolutionary part' the owner asked for: Nightwish's Endless Forms Most Beautiful picture, a hominid in forest, a dinosaur skeleton, Darwin's text and the anatomical plates. No game footage anywhere in it, which is how the owner identified it. The CLEAN front is used deliberately: the delivered act burns a title card, THE PLATFORM WARS card and a [ PREPARE FOR TITANFALL ] card on top of this picture as separate overlays, and the owner ruled 'no titanfall, this is going to be strictly onboard' -- cutting from the clean render excludes all three by construction rather than by trimming around them. In at 4.0 where the picture fades up out of the black head; out at 70.4667 where the Perfume audio ends, so the join is SILENT and phrase-safe. The trailer then starts on a hard cut: owner, 'I want to not have a slide, slide right into the trailer dramatically. Jump cut'.

cuts.note: The ESRB 'TEEN / Blood Language Violence' rating slate, measured as shot 00 (0.000-1.969) by ContentDetector. The intro hard-cuts straight into the trailer -- owner: 'slide right into the trailer dramatically. Jump cut' -- and the first delivered build landed that cut on the rating card, which is a legal slate rather than picture. Removed whole, on the measured shot boundary, so the cut lands on the first frame of the Throne World waterline instead. Same posture as act II removing the publisher end cards: the film does not open on an advert.
